sloka: ततो वासमुपागम्य गोमतीतीर आश्रमे ।प्रभाते पुनरुत्थाय सौमित्रिः सूतमब्रवीत् ।। ७.४६.१९ ॥
transliteration: tato vāsamupāgamya gomatītīra āśrame ।prabhāte punarutthāya saumitriḥ sūtamabravīt ।। 7.46.19 ॥

translations.english: Then, having stayed in a hermitage on the bank of the Gomati, Lakshmana rose again in the morning and spoke to the charioteer.
